summary: Wrote dft/dft_plan.md (Phase 0, plan only): test strategy, scan approach (single full-scan muxed-flop chain, single clk), test pins (scan_en, scan_in, scan_out, optional test_mode), expected coverage method (stuck-at plus LOC transition via ATPG, no number claimed), memory test approach (no memories, MBIST not applicable), and limitations of the open flow (no scan insertion or ATPG step). Nothing was run; no tool checks are claimed.
assumptions: A single scan chain on the single clk domain is the starting assumption for such a small design.
Phase 1 coverage targets live in PHASE_GATES.md/Appendix and are deliberately not restated as claims.
The flop count (about 105) is the architecture estimate from arch.yaml, not a measured value.
The spec contains no scan/test pins, so the pin table is a proposal that needs a human decision.
open_issues: Scan hold timing: pre-layout ff-corner hold slack is small, so scan shift paths need a post-CTS hold check in Phase 1.
Scan insertion and ATPG are not available in the open flow; tool choice for Phase 1 is open.
Spec interface has no scan_en/scan_in/scan_out/test_mode pins; adding them (or sharing functional pins) changes the interface and needs a human/G1 decision.

self_assessment.reason: All six sections are present and no coverage number is claimed, but the plan rests on architecture estimates and an unverified pin proposal, and no tool has checked it.
